release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.14 consolidates the interface from 15 top-level tabs to 10 primary workspaces without removing any underlying feature pane. The new primary hierarchy is Dashboard, Drops, Tasks, Automation, Orders, Profiles, Accounts, Proxies, Operations, and Settings. Accounts now contains Retailer Accounts and Sessions; Operations contains Live Operations and Diagnostics; Settings contains Account, Appearance, Updates, and Guides. Existing deep links and internal routes remain compatible and automatically highlight the correct parent workspace. Classic/Top navigation is re-spaced into a centered readable single row, Sidebar rows are rebalanced with a bounded Owner Vault/Announcements footer, and Command Center mirrors the same ten-destination hierarchy. The first-launch Welcome Tour is rebuilt around the new structure as four concise screens with two groups of five larger interactive previews; Accounts, Operations, and Settings previews explain their secondary sections, and all preview controls remain sandboxed from live application state. Existing users who completed the v0.45.13 tour migrate silently. Release validation preserves all 15 internal pane contracts while protecting the new 10-workspace public navigation, and the merged patch passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E including the real Wails/WebView2 shell, and CodeQL before Stable promotion.
